profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kinecta Federal Credit Union
profile.summary:
Over the past 11 years, my professional experience and passion has been building relationships with my clients, prospects, business partners and internal resources in order to assist in the alignment of the products and services I represent with an organization’s business objectives and priorities. My career has allowed me to develop these relationships not only in the United States, but also in South America and Europe.

Feel free to contact me at ramirez.e.jonathan@gmail.com

company.name: Konica Minolta Business Solutions U.S.A., Inc.

positions.title: Western US Sales Manager
positions.description:
Developed new accounts, sales strategy, and managed key accounts. Supervised customer trials from concept to completion.

•	Promoted company products and services. This includes marketing strategy and tactics, product demonstrations, sales techniques, and sales control systems
•	Assessed customer needs and quality standards for services
•	Analyzed information and evaluated results to choose the best solution and solve client problems
•	Evaluated customer satisfaction
•	Handled complaints, settled disputes, and resolved grievances and conflicts.
•	Established long-range objectives and specified the strategies and actions to achieve them

positions.title: National Account Executive
positions.description:
Managed key distribution accounts, developed marketing strategies and sales presentations. Coordinated tradeshows and managed client relations; all with the goal of selling company products.

•	Began in the RestaurantBags.com E-Commerce division
•	Consistently exceeded historical growth sales target month after month
•	Promoted after only six months to National Account Executive in the Retail Division
•	Key accounts include: City Paper Company, Oakland Packaging & Supply Inc., Morgan Chaney, LLC, Carolina Retail Packaging, Pacific Western Sales, The Salvation Army, and Jan Way Corporation
•	Closed Claire’s Stores Inc. order worth $138,000
•	Closed Turner’s Outdoorsman worth $35,000
•	Recovered over $150,000 in revenue from 2013 lost accounts through new distribution account print jobs

positions.title: International & Western US Regional Sales Account Manager
positions.description:
Managed key distribution accounts, developed marketing strategies and sales presentations. Coordinated tradeshows and managed client relations; all with the goal of selling company products.
Sold to major distributors, dealers, and end-users throughout the world. Worked with clients in the American, Latin American, European and Eastern markets. 

•	Key accounts include: Easy Com Audio(France), Intelware (France), PASS-Medientechnik(Germany), Eurocase Audio En Media(Holland), Advanced Media(U.A.E.), Imagenbol S.R.L (Bolivia), Synnex Corp. (California), Comp View Inc.(Oregon) and Aatronics(Idaho)
•	Bridged the gap between European market culture and US sales strategies
•	Interfaced with: CEOs, Buyers, Warehouse Managers, and with all staff in growing long-term relationships
•	Closed US military sale in Germany worth $100,000
•	Closed Irish military sale worth $48,000
•	Brought in 20 new resellers in France, 10 new resellers in Germany, 7 new resellers in Spain, 5 new resellers across eastern Europe, and 15 new resellers across the western US
•	Successfully organized key trade shows in the US, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, London, Paris, and Prague to grow brand awareness and create demand

positions.title: Sales Support Specialist
positions.description: Provided support to sales representatives, made inside sales calls, prepared sales and marketing materials, processed orders, and managed customer relations.
